title.zh: 将罗哈斯市Sibaguan小学的名称正式变更为Juan Fuentes小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Sibaguan Elementary School in the City of Roxas to Juan Fuentes Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Sibaguan Elementary School in the City of Roxas to Juan Fuentes Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Sibaguan tại Thành phố Roxas thành Trường tiểu học Juan Fuentes
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Sibaguan ในเมือง Roxas เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Juan Fuentes
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Sibaguan di Kota Roxas menjadi Sekolah Dasar Juan Fuentes
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Sibaguan di Bandaraya Roxas menjadi Sekolah Rendah Juan Fuentes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5603_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Sibaguan Elementary School in the City of Roxas is hereby changed, to Juan Fuentes Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
